1.w: A thanksgiving psalm. Shout out praises to the Lord , all the earth!

2.w: Worship the Lord with joy. Enter his presence with joyful singing.

3.w: Acknowledge that the Lord is God. He made us and we belong to him, we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.

4.w: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise. Give him thanks. Praise his name.

5.w: For the Lord is good. His loyal love endures, and he is faithful through all generations.
